name_input: NATURE ONE FRESH PRODUCE PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs records page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/nature-one-fresh-produce-private-limited): "Total Shipments 3303 Records detected ... Latest Cargo 2026-02-28"; exact row quoted: "2026-02-28 | NATURE ONE FRESH PRODUCE PRIVATE LIMITED | TO ORDER | FRESH FRUIT BANANA, (BANANA PACKED IN CORRUGATED CARTONS OF 13.00 KGS NET WT. 14.20 KGS GROSS WT.) | NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India | Jebel Ali, UNITED ARAB EMIRATES | 08039010 | 1115627". Further rows seen on the same page: 2026-02-27 Jebel Ali UAE HS 08039010 BOL 1099242; 2026-02-26 Latakia, Syria HS 08039010 BOL 1038916; 2026-02-25 Umm Qasr, Iraq HS 08039010 BOL 1016909; 2026-02-24 Umm Qasr, Iraq HS 08039010 BOL 9974365. Top ports listed: NHAVA SHEVA SEA 459, NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1 457, Umm Qasr 362, Latakia 232, Jeddah 107. Source counter: page claims 3303 total shipments; 5 individual dated rows actually visible in the free view (rest behind paywall).
note: Export side is factually confirmed: real sea shipments of fresh bananas (HS 08039010) ex Nhava Sheva to UAE, Syria and Iraq with dated customs rows and B/L numbers, latest 2026-02-28. Declared HS codes in the batch (070190;070490;071040;071140 — potatoes, cabbage, sweet corn, cucumbers) do NOT match the observed actual shipments, which are bananas under HS 08039010; per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground — the company stays in the base and the HS code should be corrected to the factual 08039010 (verdict accepted_hs_corrected). Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could not be retrieved: web_search backend returned 'Connection refused' on both attempts, and thecompanycheck.com, zaubacorp.com, volza.com and eximpedia.app all returned HTTP 403. Therefore domestic_status = unknown, not 'none_found' — absence of evidence here is a tooling limitation, not a finding. Revenue and export volume figures are not public in the free views: null, not estimated. Registered address shown in the customs record: 502, 5th Floor, Haroon House, 294/294 A, Perin Nariman Street, Fort (Mumbai) — CIN/PAN not verified, left null.
